pick.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
pick.what: Hosted proxy in front of any provider: analytics, caching, rate limiting, fallbacks, BYOK
pick.why: No servers to run, core features free on all plans, host-agnostic; exit cost is one base URL
pick.free_limits: Core features (dashboard analytics, caching, rate limiting) free on all plans. Legacy Logs: 100,000 total on Workers Free, 10M per gateway on Workers Paid; accounts whose first gateway was created on/after 2026-09-24 use Workers Logs pricing. Unified Billing credits carry a 5% fee; provider inference passed through with no markup.

best_free.name: Bifrost (Maxim)
best_free.what: Open-source Go AI gateway with one OpenAI-compatible API, failover, load balancing, caching
best_free.why: Fast self-host gateway, Apache-2.0, no per-request fees
best_free.maintained: release date not shown on repo page (opened 2026-10-28)

alts.name: Vercel AI Gateway
alts.why: Cleanest if the app is on Vercel with AI SDK

candidates.name: LiteLLM
candidates.verdict: Alt: self-host for regulated data/virtual keys; 2026 PyPI supply-chain compromise

candidates.name: OpenRouter
candidates.verdict: Better as model source than control plane; 5.5% fee

candidates.name: Bifrost (Maxim, Go, Apache-2.0)
candidates.verdict: Fast self-host gateway; no TS SDK info seen

candidates.name: Portkey OSS gateway
candidates.verdict: Acquired by Palo Alto Networks (announced 2026-04-30, reported closed 2026-05-29) - roadmap now security-product driven

candidates.name: No gateway (AI SDK provider swap only)
candidates.verdict: Valid until multiple providers in prod

decision: A small team should not run a gateway server; Cloudflare AI Gateway gives caching, limits and logs free with one URL of lock-in. Switch to self-hosted LiteLLM (or Bifrost) when regulated data must not transit a third-party proxy or you need per-tenant budgets.
details: Gateways see all prompts - confirm a DPA/BAA before routing regulated data (Cloudflare BAA status unverified).

verify.note: Numbers confirmed; the 2026-09-24 cutover is per account (first gateway), not per gateway.
